title: Toolchain component skew breaks embed consumers silently
commons_coordination: No Commons record filed: MNCS-Commons checkout is on another agent's campaign branch. The owning layer is mncs-language build/packaging (branch-active).
observed_need: The `mncs` binary and libmncs_embed.so must be built and versioned together; a refreshed binary with a stale embed library must fail with a component-skew diagnostic, not an AttributeError.
current_language_behavior: The workspace carried a current `mncs` binary (Oct 1) with a stale libmncs_embed.so (Sep 24). ctypes consumers failed with `undefined symbol: mncs_session_callable_bindings`, which reads as a source-level API break rather than a stale artifact. Rebuilding the embed package fixed it with no source change.
why_insufficient: Nothing binds the two artifacts: no version gate, no build receipt, and `cargo build -p mncs-embed` freshness depends on which packages the last builder happened to compile.
minimal_reproducer: At spark-test baseline, tests/test_runner.py::test_first_class_failing_assertion_uses_native_suite_fold errored with the undefined-symbol AttributeError; after rebuilding libmncs_embed.so the full 22-test suite passed unmodified.
desired_direction: Version-gate the embed ABI (build receipts or a symbol/version handshake at session open) and document the canonical full-toolchain build so partial rebuilds cannot ship skew.
workaround: Rebuild libmncs_embed.so from the same checkout before running the embed-backed suite. No mncs-test source change needed or made.
